description: Source file implementing Direct3D (D3D) surfaces for EGL in ANGLE project, including class SurfaceD3D and related surface types.

classes.name: SurfaceD3D
classes.description: Implements an EGL surface using Direct3D for rendering, managing swap chains, textures, and surface properties.

classes.name: WindowSurfaceD3D
classes.description: Derived class representing a window-based EGL surface using D3D.

classes.name: PbufferSurfaceD3D
classes.description: Derived class representing a pixel buffer (pbuffer) EGL surface using D3D.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the D3D surface, including swap chain creation and texture info retrieval.

methods.name: resetSwapChain
methods.description: Creates or resets the swap chain for the surface based on current window or fixed size.

methods.name: resizeSwapChain
methods.description: Resizes the swap chain buffers to match new dimensions.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the front and back buffers to present the rendered content.

methods.name: swapRect
methods.description: Performs a partial buffer swap for a specified rectangle.

methods.name: getSyncValues
methods.description: Retrieves synchronization values for the swap chain.

methods.name: querySurfacePointerANGLE
methods.description: Queries surface-related pointers, such as share handle or keyed mutex.
